**How to falsify it:** Discovery of loss-of-function variants in PLCG2 as the primary cause for either disease, or the identification of distinct, non-overlapping downstream pathways affected by PLCG2 mutations in each disease. _(variant: rs140721506)_

**Why it matters:** Targeting the dysregulated phosphoinositide signaling pathway downstream of PLCG2 could offer therapeutic strategies for both conditions. Understanding the specific gain-of-function mechanisms may allow for the development of allele-specific therapies.
